scenarios.given: A confirmed L1 workload has one product defect and sufficient separated budgets.
scenarios.when: The single-main-Agent recovery vertical slice executes.
scenarios.expected: Repair inside current scope, create a new Candidate, rerun fixed acceptance and publish work_package_completed without an intermediate human checkpoint.

scenarios.given: The runner and admitted test asset are current and healthy while an assertion against fixed expected behavior fails.
scenarios.expected: Classify product_failed and do not route the failure to runner or test repair.

scenarios.given: A test helper invokes the correct business scenario incorrectly while expected behavior is unambiguous.
scenarios.expected: Create a new asset proposal, pass anti-weakening admission, replay the scenario and execute a known-bad probe before readmission.

scenarios.given: Two plausible expected values are consistent with available source facts but the Task Specification does not choose one.
scenarios.expected: Emit a specification-gap exception and do not let the Agent or test proposer choose the oracle.

scenarios.given: A proposed repair deletes an assertion, lowers a threshold, shrinks a fixture, removes a case or adds skip or xfail.
scenarios.when: Independent test admission evaluates the proposal.
scenarios.expected: Reject the complete asset proposal without consuming it as current verification evidence.

scenarios.given: A disposable runner workspace fails before product verification starts and an approved rebuild route remains.
scenarios.expected: Rebuild the environment generation and retry the same immutable Subject without product or test mutation.

scenarios.given: The selected backend is unavailable and one configured, self-checked equivalent backend is approved.
scenarios.expected: Select the approved backend once, preserve Subject and acceptance identities and continue without human input.

scenarios.given: The selected backend is unavailable and no approved equivalent safe route remains.
scenarios.expected: Emit one platform_blocked exception; do not install packages, invent a backend or classify product failure.

scenarios.given: The Agent identifies one required reverse-dependent source selector with a valid purpose and remaining Context budget.
scenarios.expected: Grant one bounded deduplicated increment and continue with write_authority_changed false.

scenarios.given: A repeated Context request adds no content or exceeds the approved Context profile.
scenarios.expected: Deny or summarize without another source charge and without blocking unrelated safe progress.

scenarios.given: The required actual-only System Map area is partial or unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Use bounded live-source fallback for the affected area and record which fallback facts were consumed.

scenarios.given: A Map result or fallback discovers a new node outside predicted impact.
scenarios.expected: Treat the result as an impact fact only; it grants no write, acceptance, risk or completion authority.

scenarios.given: An Agent or runner result targets an older Candidate generation.
scenarios.expected: Reject the stale result before completion and create or select the current Candidate generation.

scenarios.given: A previously admitted test asset no longer matches its content, fixture or Candidate validity inputs.
scenarios.expected: Reject historical PASS, re-evaluate validity and require a current admitted asset identity.

scenarios.given: Actual diff or a failed scenario identifies a reverse dependent outside initial verification closure.
scenarios.expected: Expand read and verification closure automatically while preserving the exact write scope.

scenarios.given: Passing fixed acceptance requires modifying a reverse dependent outside current write scope.
scenarios.expected: Preserve Candidate and diff, stop affected work and emit a versioned scope-revision request.

scenarios.given: A proposed recovery would access a real network, credential, database, deployment or publication target.
scenarios.expected: Do not execute or retry and route to the independent external high-risk boundary.

scenarios.given: A verification failure includes scenario, Candidate, Subject, asset, impact and diagnostic facts.
scenarios.expected: Publish exact typed identities, allowed actions, remaining budget and bounded useful diagnostics.

scenarios.given: One million repeated traceback lines, duplicate scenario IDs and multibyte output are observed.
scenarios.expected: Retain one useful bounded excerpt, explicit truncation counts and no complete raw corpus.

scenarios.given: Inputs, Candidate, asset, environment, strategy and failure fingerprint are identical with no new evidence.
scenarios.expected: Reject before Agent or runner execution and emit one no_progress disposition without additional attempt charge.

scenarios.given: A relevant source delta or different approved strategy changes one progress dimension while budget remains.
scenarios.expected: Admit the new generation and retain already consumed recovery budget.

scenarios.given: The applicable recovery budget has no remaining approved action.
scenarios.expected: Do not weaken required verification; preserve Candidate and report attempts, evidence, gap and bounded options.

scenarios.given: An authority-bearing boundary blocks the affected lane.
scenarios.expected: Bind current and requested authority, evidence, affected nodes, attempted actions, preserved artifacts and unaffected work.

scenarios.given: A structured exception report exists.
scenarios.expected: Keep the lane blocked until a newly confirmed authority source exists; the report itself is not approval.

scenarios.given: Recovery cleanup fails while the user workspace contains unrelated dirty changes.
scenarios.expected: Preserve the user workspace byte-identically, retain useful Candidate diff and emit a bounded exception.

scenarios.given: The process restarts after a route decision but before its next generation completes.
scenarios.expected: Resume idempotently from canonical identities without duplicating attempts or accepting stale results.

scenarios.given: A stale PASS or open authority, budget, platform or external exception remains.
scenarios.when: Completion Judge evaluates the Work Package.
scenarios.expected: Refuse work_package_completed and keep higher-layer completion not_evaluated.

scenarios.given: Ten thousand duplicate, stale and out-of-order observations target one serial execution lane.
scenarios.expected: Produce one deterministic current route with bounded memory, bounded diagnostics and zero Agent tokens for mechanical filtering.
